Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent PNG sprite for a 360-degree character viewer.
Reference image is the approved Tennis Boy 02 turnaround sheet; it is the authority for identity, clothing, proportions, pose and equipment. Output ONE full-body character only, NOT a sheet.
Square canvas 1024x1024, genuinely transparent alpha background (including spaces between racket strings), no background color, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no floor or cast/contact shadow. Full body and entire racket visible. Constant orthographic camera at torso height, no lens distortion. Top of cap at y=80, soles at y=944, body vertical axis centered at x=512. Keep these identical for every angle; empty side margins are intentional.
Preserve oversized head, black tousled hair, navy baseball cap with reference white WildThings lettering where visible, black oval eyes, royal blue T-shirt, black shorts, black wristbands, navy socks and navy sneakers with white accents, fine fabric texture, high quality softly lit 3D toy render.
Fixed pose in ALL frames: standing relaxed, feet slightly apart, arms lowered. Anatomical RIGHT hand firmly holds gray grip of red/black tennis racket, head hanging downward and slightly outward beside right leg; anatomical LEFT hand holds one yellow tennis ball. Rotate the entire fixed figure and equipment together, not a new pose. The racket face plane follows the front plane of the body, so it becomes narrow at exact profile. Never swap hands or mirror lettering. Stable neutral soft lighting, same blue and navy colors, no props beyond the held ball and racket.
TARGET VIEW: 0 degrees, precisely straight FRONT, symmetrical eye visibility and shoulders, both shoes facing camera. Racket at viewer LEFT and yellow ball at viewer RIGHT. Match the leftmost approved sheet figure, but true straight-on front.
